anchor_line: the chain's own kind: anchor line for a date is written after 00:00 new york of the next day (planter.py anchor-line); an anchor text written before the day closes is provisional: a later line of that day would move the day's head
posted_to: no chat: the anchor text is this file, stamped, and committed to the exhibit branch
what_a_proof_attests: that the bytes of the .txt file existed before the Bitcoin block named in the proof; not that the chain is complete, nor that any text was sent anywhere (none was)
